summary: Highly experienced Senior Software Engineer with 45+ years in software development, specializing in AI-driven platforms, machine learning infrastructure, and robust test automation. Proven expertise in TypeScript, Python, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including Vertex AI, developing scalable ML pipelines and full-stack applications. Adept at leveraging large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tools for advanced software development, testing, and documentation.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Led AI-assisted software development and GenAI application to testing and documentation, leveraging LLMs (Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Perplexity.ai, GitHub Copilot) for full-stack development.

Designed and built Vertex AI-powered 'Hire Me' AI Tools Suite, including a Custom Resume Generator and 'How Do I Fit?' job analysis tool, utilizing TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Google Cloud backend.
Developed 'Photo Fun,' an AI-powered photo transformation app using Google Gemini, TypeScript, React, and Firebase, hosted on Vercel with Vertex AI for production.
Implemented 'Tensor Logic,' an interactive demo bridging neural and symbolic AI paradigms, featuring a Rust/Axum backend deployed on Shuttle.rs and a TypeScript/Vite frontend.
Constructed personal portfolio website (samkirk.com) with Google Cloud backend (Vertex AI, Firestore, Cloud Storage), showcasing AI-powered hiring tools and interactive explorations.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Developed hardware and software configurations for three standalone Production Test stations for hi-speed digital logic emulation, utilizing Python 2.7 and Debian Linux.
Co-designed and developed a test station for a Cooling Unit, including custom Device Interface Board (DIB) and Python 2.7 software for 5 BeagleBone Black microcomputers.
Created telemetry event data log visualization using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib, developing time-series plots and cross-tabulations for system status analysis.
Developed host production test program within an existing Python framework and constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned data.
Implemented environmental data collection and logging in Python, synchronous with system-level test logging for correlated time-series analysis.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python 2.7 for automotive Over the Air (OTA) firmware update testing, mediating between cloud servers and vehicular hardware.
Revised the test framework for expansion and scalability, implementing 3 levels of logging and 2 levels of stop-on-fail control for test execution.
Built iteration over modular, dynamically loaded test procedures with full context management and implemented concurrent application log following during test execution.
Created extensive YAML configuration files for test parameterization, utilizing Python modules such as Selenium, paramiko, and json.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Proposed and supported basic service plans and Quality of Service (QoS) plans for cellular radio testing in manufacturing for medical point-of-care test instruments.
Performed verification testing for instrument software, including 9 USB-based updating tests and several manual regression tests.
Created API Reference documentation using a novel Sphinx extension and managed its internal web hosting.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented Span Adjustment, Drive Alignment, and Compare Alignment timing calibration for a 192-channel digital ATE instrument, with two implemented in C++.
Utilized custom Python scripts for generating various XML timing patterns, marking initial professional use of Python.

experience.title: Sr. Test Program Engineer
bullets: Developed functional and performance testing for SSDs with SATA, SAS, and PCIe interfaces on Linux using C and Perl.
Created a Linux PC-based test station platform with complete physical enumeration of DUTs for JEDEC Endurance Testing.
Mentored a new college graduate in SSD test development, fostering skill growth in test methodologies.

experience.title: Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Ported UltraSPARC T1 and VF CPU POST to telco-oriented and NEBS-qualified chassis, including online diagnostics for MPC885-based service processors running Linux.
Closed over 20 bugs on ethernet loopback test programs across all Sun platforms, serving as a key contributor to SunVTS.

experience.title: Test Development Engineer
bullets: Developed custom test equipment and C software for performance verification of source synchronous, receive-only channels in ATE instruments up to 3.2 Gb/sec.
Developed an on-line diagnostic for an Edge Measurement Calibration Subsystem (ECMS) in an ATE chip tester, achieving 1.5 picosecond accuracy using a 3D linear regression algorithm.
